authorization: User authorized venue fragmentation plus temporal concentration, and venue fragmentation plus price range, on top of pair plus flow with unchanged nested tuning.
change_scope: Only RF gains listed PDF features; liquidation pair and nine-setting nested tuning protocol unchanged.
fit_accounting: 36 inner RF fits and 4 selected outer RF fits plus 4 joint selections per candidate.
promotion_rule: Promote only verified lower same-row MAE. Track Spearman only. Keep compact history and discard losing model/prediction artifacts after verification.
selection_exposure: PDF ranking and previous model results were inspected. Feature selection is historical development selection, not untouched confirmation.
stopping_rule: Only the two announced context pairs; retain current liquidation pair plus flow in RF, no triple or added tuning.
horizon_reuse: Target horizon, label-end column, input paths, folds and benchmark are explicit. Other horizons require matching target labels and separately generated/verified pair anchors and benchmark predictions. Never reuse 48h target/model artifacts for another horizon; no other horizons run in this experiment.
selection_rule: Lowest inner blend MAE; tie: lower RF weight, then incumbent settings, then shallower depth, then larger leaf.
